command: python evaluation_runner.py [--historical-root <external ASSISTments evidence>] [--research-root <external simulation evidence>]
limitations: No causal recommendation-utility estimate is supported.
Synthetic and controlled outcomes are not real-child outcomes.
Curriculum and tier compliance are internal-policy measures.
The deployed transferable model differs from the 0.7502 research winner and is not locally calibrated.

existing_simulation.limitations: Fictional learners with programmed response generation; reliability and behavior evidence only.

reported.counterfactual_support: Supplied tests passed: changing only prediction probabilities changes selected game and tier action.

limitations: Policy-Expectation Agreement is agreement with an implementation-specification rubric, not recommendation accuracy or independent pedagogical appropriateness.
Candidate eligibility is expected to remain equal except when the intended outcome contrast activates documented Tier B evidence rules.
Synthetic response histories do not establish learning benefit, screening accuracy or clinical validity.
No pair is selected or removed based on whether its recommendation changes.
